7.22 1 Right Side

  1. so-and-so son of so-and-so and during the lifetime of the whole

  8. in truth, justice

  4. I will not diminish her

  6. and sexual intercourse like children of
  7. Israel who feed
  8. and support,

7.22 2 Left Side

  1. In the lifetime of his Glory, Highness,
